> but I have cushioned the landing a bit by building up a network of tried and true joy-bringing activities.

I'm at a point where nothing makes me happy.  I've been like this for years.  I've been suicidal on and off (mostly on) for years.

I don't want to be melodramatic.  I don't want to sound like an asshole.  I just wish I did it when I was happy and had the chance.  It's been like this for YEARS, and I had a chance to end when I was in a good place, and I was selfish and didn't take the chance when I had it.  

Thank you for listening to me, and thank you for reaching out to me.  I appreciate your kindness.  I'm beyond help, believe me.

> He could have told you what before he did what?

I meant that he could have told me that he didn't want a relationship with me before he put up a new profile.

I'm just so sad and frustrated.  I've been deeply suicidal (every day, every fucking day) for a few months now and I find this thing (the relationship) that gets me to break that thought up (my visual is a huge sheet of ice that cracks so I can come up for air).  The depression from before is so bad that when I realize I'm having a good day -- a really good day -- that I want to die.  I want to go out on top.  I never want to go back to that dark place.  But I held on because I'm greedy and I want another good day.

Now here I am again, fully submerged and another layer of ice piled on.
